directive: user 2026-10-28 ~13:50 KST: one common downstream algorithm and exactly six environments where csw4 is best or practically competitive with the strongest compared method
registered_before: any result of SNeRL-code SAC, PPO or Dreamer, and any new-task result
method: csw4 (chlrm + cs + w4), frozen encoder, pretraining seed 0, 200k
comparators: cnn (end-to-end control on the same algorithm path)
complete_group: an environment is classified only when csw4 and EVERY comparator have all registered seeds (2000, 2001, 2002) complete under the same algorithm and the same registered budget; otherwise it is "incomplete/provisional"
main_measure: last-5 training-camera evaluation episode return (mean of the last five evaluations of the registered budget; 960k-1M for 1M), environment return only (no entropy or auxiliary terms)
scale: nR = (R - R_random) / (R_expert - R_random) with the fixed per-task random-policy and scripted-expert returns of reports/results-artifact/norm/screening/summary.json (method independent; new tasks get theirs from the same screening protocol before any RL result)

reported_alongside.auc: mean of all evaluations over the budget
reported_alongside.early: mean of the evaluations in the first 20 % of the budget (10k-200k for 1M)
reported_alongside.success: last-5 training-camera success; also held-out and moving cameras as supporting

statistics: per method the mean over seeds; Delta = mean nR(csw4) - max over comparators of mean nR(comparator); uncertainty by a percentile bootstrap that resamples the seeds of EVERY method independently and recomputes the strongest comparator in each draw (B = 10000, rng seed 0); L = one-sided 95 % lower bound (5th percentile) of Delta; with three seeds per method the bounds are exploratory (reported as such); seed values always shown

tolerance.justification: delta = 0.05 is 5 % of the random-to-expert return gap, below the median seed SD of last-5 nR across the eight-task DrM results (0.063): a deficit smaller than one typical seed-to-seed fluctuation is treated as practically equal. The floor L >= -0.15 (three tolerances) excludes cases where the data remain compatible with csw4 being substantially worse; overlapping intervals alone never qualify, because the point estimate must also be within delta.
tolerance.interpretation: two separate statements, never merged into a non-inferiority claim: the point estimate is within 0.05 of the strongest comparator, and the data do not allow csw4 to be more than 0.15 behind it (L >= -0.15). "Practically competitive" always carries this uncertainty qualification; a formal 5 % non-inferiority claim (L >= -0.05) is reported separately when it holds.

classes.inconclusive: Delta >= -0.05 but L < -0.15, or the group is incomplete (provisional)

qualifying: highest or within_tolerance with a complete group
ranking_among_qualifying: tier 1: every csw4 seed reaches last-5 nR >= 0.5 x the csw4 seed mean (consistent learning) AND csw4 last-5 training-camera success >= 0.2 (meaningful success); tier 2: the rest
within a tier: larger Delta_CNN = mean nR(csw4) - mean nR(cnn)
skill diversity: greedy pick in that order, skipping an environment whose skill family already has two picks while a qualifying environment of another family remains
algorithm_choice: one common downstream algorithm for the main comparison: the algorithm with the most qualifying environments (counted up to six); ties -> larger sum of Delta_CNN over its six picks -> lower compute. Never a different algorithm per environment.
reporting: exploratory and performance-informed selection; every tested environment, algorithm, seed and screening run stays visible (including unfavourable ones); if fewer than six qualify the selection is reported as provisional and the bounded exploration continues; the criterion is not changed afterwards
early_screening: seed 2000 screening runs only decide which complete comparisons to expand to seeds 2000-2002; they never qualify an environment by themselves

amends.why: Codex review 2026-10-28 of the registered rule; amended before any SNeRL-code SAC, PPO, Dreamer or new-task result exists

confirmation: selection optimism control: the screening seed 2000 only chooses which complete groups to expand; a qualifying environment additionally needs Delta computed on the fresh seeds 2001-2002 alone (all methods) to be >= -0.05, i.e. the classification must hold on data that did not drive the expansion

algorithms: SNeRL-code SAC (8 existing tasks + new tasks)
search_bound.new_task_batches: at most 3 batches of at most 4 tasks (batch 1: drawer-open, window-open, soccer, sweep-into)
search_bound.stopping: stop when six environments qualify under one algorithm, or when the bound is exhausted; then report the qualifying set as provisional with every tested setting
